primaryChecks.text: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
primaryChecks.previousContext: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah began to reign over Judah.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Abijah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men; and Jeroboam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
